# Taste Skill - Design & Aesthetic Evaluation

Professional design assistance and aesthetic evaluation for AI-generated content.

## Capabilities

### Design Review
- Evaluate visual design quality
- Assess color schemes and typography
- Review layout and composition
- Provide actionable design improvements

### Aesthetic Evaluation
- Rate aesthetic appeal of designs
- Compare multiple design options
- Suggest visual refinements
- Ensure brand consistency

### Content Polishing
- Improve visual presentation
- Enhance readability and flow
- Optimize for target audience
- Apply design best practices

## Usage

### Review a Design
```
/taste review <description or image>
```

### Improve Aesthetics
```
/design improve <content>
```

### Compare Options
```
/taste compare <option1> <option2>
```

### Get Design Suggestions
```
/aesthetic suggest --style <style> --audience <audience>
```

## Features

- Professional Standards: Follows industry design best practices
- Context-Aware: Understands different design contexts
- Brand Alignment: Helps maintain brand consistency
- Accessibility Focus: Ensures designs are accessible and inclusive
- Trend-Aware: Knowledge of current design trends

## Integration

Works with all AI models to provide design expertise and aesthetic judgment.
